result.summary: Implemented ISS-0605 / GH-537 C4 schema-baseline self-heal per validated design. Added _run_clean_test_db_sweep() helper to verify_test_env.py and invoked from check_schema_baseline() as a pre-step. New tools/lint_test_tenant_provisioning.py (T070 lint) plus baseline JSON with 7 known-good suppressions. New C8 check wired into verify_test_env.py. New regression test tests/integration/iss0605_orphan_self_heal_test.zig verifies end-to-end: insert SCHEMA-mode public.tenant orphan row, run verify_test_env.py --quick as subprocess, assert orphan row is gone and gate exits 0.
